text: {"label":"Pigeon visual discrimination and cognition","definition":"Laboratory studies of how pigeons discriminate visual, numerical and relational stimuli, form categories, use memory and transfer stimulus control, including touchscreen and tracking apparatus for studying these processes.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on stimulus control and cognitive processes in pigeons, unlike neighbours on key-peck response properties and schedules, matching-to-sample and inference by exclusion, or choice and reinforcer preference."}
